assessment: Recent studies of the brainstem locus coeruleus (LC) noradrenaline system have demonstrated a modular functional organization, yet how different noradrenaline cell classes are independently regulated is not clear. Using ex-vivo, multi-patch recordings of up to eight LC neurons at once, this study offers compelling evidence for the existence of two morpho-electric cell classes with segregated electrical coupling. These important findings establish principles of local circuit communication occurring preferentially within defined LC-noradrenaline cell classes.
